Name: GLOBAL:SOFAConventions
Comment: This convention set is for impulse responses recorded under free-field conditions or conditions with irrelevant room information.

Name: GLOBAL:License
Default: No license provided, ask the author for permission

Name: GLOBAL:DatabaseName
Comment: Unique name of the database to which these data belong.

Name: GLOBAL:ListenerShortName
Comment: ID of the subject from the database.

Name: SourcePosition
Comment: The source position is assumed to vary around the listener.

Name: EmitterPosition
Comment: Source consists of a single Emitter only.

Name: Data.SamplingRate
Comment: Sampling rate of the samples in Data.IR and Data.Delay.

Name: Data.Delay
Comment: Additional delay of each IR (in samples, with the time interval as described by SamplingRate).

Name: Normalization
Comment: Index to the applied normalization method. 0: Custom or unspecified; 1: Diffuse-field equalized (Theile, 1986); 2: Directional transfer functions (Middlebrooks and Green, 1992); 3: Across-databases normalization (Bahu et al., 2025).

Name: Normalization:References
Comment: References to publications describing the normalization.

Name: Normalization:URI
Comment: URIs or DOIs to publications describing the normalization.
